title: Trade ideas
dek: Inner trade ideas: five trades on one freight regime, with contract selection, carry math, expected moves, and drawdown-capped sizing.

claims.text: ICE December 2026, October 9, 2026 settles: TMW -25.60 (180 lots), TMR -2.50 (30 lots), TMS +4.65 (0 lots). November contracts are in their settlement window and traded zero volume.

WCS carry math on October 9, 2026 marks: implied WCS outright December $65.16, January $65.23, a $0.07 deferral premium against roughly $0.90/bbl full carry (storage plus financing). Gap about $0.85/bbl.
claims.source: CalRock broker marks (private); house carry construction

claims.text: S&D model: supply 4,866 kb/d October 2026, 5,167 November (+301 against October) and 5,213 December (+346 against October; December only about 45 kb/d above November); 52 kb/d (November) and 95 kb/d (December) carried as requiring a price response; pipeline spare capacity zero. The step is turnaround returns: the maintenance schedule carries 310 kb/d offline in September, 164 in October, 23 in November, 3 in December, and the model carries no named new-production adds for November or December.
claims.vintage: Balance model vintage September 28, 2026; maintenance forward calendar September 22, 2026

claims.text: TMW December 2026 to January 2027 roll on ICE settles: +0.95 on September 30, 2026, +1.30 on October 9 (full series printed on the page; October 12 file carries October 9 values at zero volume), against roughly $0.90/bbl of full carry. Synthetic crude minus WCS spread: +27.15 (September 30) to +31.24 (October 9) on ICE November settles; +30.30 (October 2) to +35.30 (October 9) on November CalRock marks.
claims.vintage: ICE settlements and CalRock marks, September 30 to October 9, 2026
claims.source: ICE Endex report center; CalRock broker marks (private)

claims.text: SYN minus WCS reversion test on 2025 CalRock marks: Sharpe 1.10 net, hit rate 43.2 percent, half-life about 9.5 trading days, max drawdown -$2.75 against +$4.85 total. Spread at +31.24 (ICE, October 9, 2026) against a 2025 range of +7.25 to +15.00; rule stood down, no current-regime 60-day band exists.
OFAC General License 135 issued October 9, 2026, expires April 7, 2027, names no volumes, buyers, or counterparties.
claims.source: United States Office of Foreign Assets Control
